title: RetryLinkage
description: One human-directed correction retry after a refused AI edit.

retry_linkage_id.description: Stable id for this retry-linkage fact.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

user_id.description: The developer identity when known. Null when capture omitted it.

agent_harness.description: Which coding agent harness produced this fact.

file_path.description: The path the harness reported for both edit attempts. It may be absolute or repo-relative.

tool_name.description: The edit tool shared by the rejected call and accepted retry.

rejected_call_id.description: The refused edit tool-call id that started the retry.

accepted_call_id.description: The later accepted edit tool-call id.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened, stamped client-side — distinct from `captured_at`, which is when Sediment stored it.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

raw.description: The source payload after Basic redaction, kept so a translator defect stays recoverable. Shape varies by provider; never join on it.
